content: Yesu ipet ki naŋgaŋ kini isu yok tatiliuŋana Tiberias ka peende
Kaimer to Yesu ila ipet kizin naŋgaŋ kini isu yok tatiliuŋana Tiberias ka peende. Ipet ta kembei:
Simon Petrus, Tomas (ta zaana toro Didimus na), Natanael (ni kar kini Kana ta Galilea na), Zebedi lutuunu bizin ru, mi naŋgaŋ ru tomen ta ziŋan timbotmbot.

To Simon Petrus isu mi iso pa waene bizin tana. Iso: “Nio iŋgi aŋla aŋwaaza kanda i.” Mi zin pakan tiso: “Soom. Niam ko itiŋan.” Tana tise wooŋgo mi tila, to titekteegi ma mankwoono. Tamen tikam ye sa som.
Lele imarmar mi Yesu ila ipet ma imendernder su peende. Mi tire la pini, tamen tikilaali som.
To ni iwi la pizin ma iso: “Ou tiziŋan, kakam koyom ye sa?” Mi tipekel kwoono ma tiso: “Wai, som kat.”
To ni iso pizin ma iso: “Kena kotoombo ma kipiri pu isula ki nomoyom woono ten.” Tana tipiri pu isula. Beso tiyo ma ise na, tirao som. Pa ye tila ma bok kat.

Tona naŋgaŋ ta Yesu leleene pini ilip na, iso lae pa Petrus ma iso: “Ouo, iŋga Merere tau!” Petrus ileŋ sua kini tana, na loŋa men mi iur mburu kini mat kana ila niini mini, mi ilu i sula ma ilela pa peende.
Mi naŋgaŋ pakan, zin timbot wooŋgo mi tiyaaru pu ta bok pa ye na, mi tito i ma tilela pa peende. Pa zin timbot molo pa peende som. Tilela peende, to tire narabu ma ye imbot sala you.
Tona Yesu iso pizin ma iso: “Ye ta buri kakam ma kele na, pakan imar.”

Tana Simon Petrus ipera ma isala wooŋgo, mi iyaaru pu raama ye ma ilela pa peende. Pu tina, ye tilela ma bok kat mabe rek. Mi ye ta sorok som. Ye ta bibip men. Mi tinin zin na irao tomto lamata, tomtooru, laamuru mi tel (153).
To Yesu iso pizin ma iso: “Kamar ma kakan kini.” Naŋgaŋ kini tiute: Ni Merere kizin. Tamen tasa kwoono ikam kak ma iwi kati som.
To Yesu namaana ila pa narabu ma ye mi irai pizin.
Yesu imeete mi imaŋga mini pa naala na, ipet kizin naŋgaŋ kini pa ru. Mi toro ti ta iwe tel pa.
Yesu iur Petrus pa uraata mini

Zin tikan kini ma imap, to Yesu iwi Simon Petrus ma iso: “Simon, Yoan lutuunu, parei? Nu lelem pio ma ilip pa zin pakan taiŋgi, som som?” Petrus ipekel kwoono ma iso: “E! Merere, nu ute nio leleŋ pu.” Mi Yesu iso pini: “Kena putu zin sipsip tio lutunlutun.”

To Yesu iwi i mini ma iwe ru pa. Iso: “Simon, Yoan lutuunu, nu lelem pio ilip, som som?” Mi ni ipekel kalŋaana ma iso: “E! Merere nu ute nio leleŋ pu.” Mi Yesu iso pini ma iso: “Kena motom pizin sipsip tio.”

To Yesu iwi i mini ma iwe tel pa. Iso: “Simon, Yoan lutuunu, nu lelem pio, som som?” Tabe Petrus leleene ipata. Pa Yesu ikam wiŋana tana pini pa tel kek. Tana ipekel kwoono ma iso: “E! Merere nu ute koroŋ ta boozomen. Nu ute nio leleŋ pu.” Mi Yesu iso pini ma iso: “Putu zin sipsip tio.

Nio aŋso kat pu ta kembei: Indeeŋe ta nu kaibiŋom na, itum urur mburu ku. Mi lele swoi ta nu lelem pa be la na, nu la men. Tamen kaimer, sombe we kolman, nako swooro nomom ma ila, mi tomtom toro ko iur mburu ku ila nim, mi iyaaru u ma la pa lele ta nu lelem pa som i.”
Sua ti, Yesu iso se ki meeteŋana ki Petrus. Pa kaimer meeteŋana kini tana ko iwe zaala be Anutu zaana iwe biibi. Mi Yesu iso pini mini ma iso: “To yo!”
Naŋgaŋ ta Yesu leleene pini ilip

To Petrus mataana imiili na, ire naŋgaŋ ta Yesu leleene pini ilip na, ni ito zin ma ziŋan tila. Muŋgu indeeŋe ta tikanan kini na, naŋgaŋ tana, ta imbot kolouŋana pa Yesu mi iwi i pa asiŋ tabe iuri la ka koi bizin naman.
Tana Petrus mataana ila kini, mi iwi Yesu pini ma iso: “Biibi, mi parei pa tomtom tiŋga?”
Mi Yesu ipekel kwoono ma iso: “Oo, ina nio ituŋ tau. Sombe leleŋ be ni imbotmbot ma irao aŋmiili ma aŋmar mini, ina koroŋ ku som. Ina koroŋ tio. Tamen nu to yo.”

Uunu tina ta kaimer sua irak ma irao naŋgaŋ kini ta boozomen ma tiso naŋgaŋ kini tana ko irao imeete som. Tamen Yesu iso sua ta kembei som. Ni iso men ta kembei: “Sombe nio leleŋ be naŋgaŋ tiŋga imbotmbot ma irao aŋmiili ma aŋmar mini, ina koroŋ tio. Mi ina koroŋ ku som.”
Naŋgaŋ tana, ta ire kat koroŋ ta boozomen taiŋgi. Tanata ipombol ka sua, mi ibeede ise ro ti. Mi niam amute: Sua kini na, sua ŋonoono men.
Sua pemetŋana
Yesu ikam uraata boozomen. Tamen uraata kini pakan tibeede se ro som. Mibe tibeede ma imap lup, so ro tana munŋaana ka tieene. Sombe totoombo be tuurpe muriini isu toono ti, nako tarao som.
